title: Easy Acces
description: A Minecraft Paper plugin that lets players open 19 different GUIs through commands with permission support.
body:
# EasyAcces

Open any crafting station, anywhere — no blocks needed.

EasyAcces gives players instant access to all 19 Minecraft GUI interfaces through simple commands like `/anvil` or `/gui enchanting`. No need to find or place blocks.

---

## Supported GUIs

| Category | GUIs |
|---|---|
| Crafting | Workbench, Anvil, Smithing Table, Grindstone, Stonecutter, Crafter |
| Magic | Enchanting Table, Brewing Stand, Beacon |
| Smelting | Furnace, Blast Furnace, Smoker |
| Storage & Other | Ender Chest, Hopper, Dispenser, Dropper, Loom, Cartography Table |

## Commands

Each GUI has its own direct command, plus a universal shortcut:

`/workbench` `/anvil` `/enchanting` `/gui <name>`

All commands support **tab-completion** — players can instantly see what's available without memorizing anything.

## Permissions

Each GUI has its own permission node:
```yaml
easyacces.anvil
easyacces.enchanting
easyacces.workbench
easyacces.*
```

Supports both **LuckPerms** and **Bukkit permissions**. Server ops bypass all checks by default.

## Configuration

Enable or disable individual GUIs in `config.yml` — only expose what your server needs. Drop it in and it works out of the box.

## Compatibility

| | |
|---|---|
| Server software | Paper / Spigot 1.21+ |
| Java | 21+ |
| Permissions | LuckPerms, Bukkit |
